excerpt.zh: 分享一些在 Unity 开发中常用的性能优化技巧，帮助你的游戏运行得更流畅。
excerpt.en: Sharing some commonly used performance optimization tips in Unity development to help your game run more smoothly.

zh.text: 为什么性能优化很重要
在游戏开发中，性能优化是一个永恒的话题。一个流畅的游戏体验可以大大提升玩家的满意度。

1. 对象池技术：复用对象，减少内存分配
2. 纹理压缩：使用合适的纹理格式
3. 批处理：合并绘制调用
4. LOD系统：根据距离调整细节

en.text: In game development, performance optimization is an eternal topic. A smooth gaming experience can greatly enhance player satisfaction.

1. Object Pooling: Reuse objects to reduce memory allocation
2. Texture Compression: Use appropriate texture formats
3. Batching: Merge draw calls
4. LOD System: Adjust detail based on distance

excerpt.zh: 深入探讨 React Hooks 的最佳实践，避免常见陷阱。
excerpt.en: Deep dive into React Hooks best practices and avoid common pitfalls.

zh.text:
1. 只在函数组件顶层调用 Hooks
2. 不要在循环、条件或嵌套函数中调用
3. 只在 React 函数组件中调用
自定义 Hooks 是复用状态逻辑的好方式，命名以 use 开头。

en.text:
1. Only call Hooks at the top level
2. Don't call Hooks inside loops, conditions, or nested functions
3. Only call Hooks from React function components
Custom Hooks are a great way to reuse state logic, named with use prefix.

excerpt.zh: 分享我在游戏开发过程中的一些心得体会和经验教训。
excerpt.en: Sharing some insights and lessons learned during my game development journey.

zh.text: 游戏开发是一个充满挑战但也非常有趣的过程。从想法到实现，每一步都需要精心打磨。

1. 保持热情：游戏开发周期长，需要持续的动力
2. 迭代开发：不要追求完美，先做出原型
3. 用户反馈：倾听玩家的声音

en.text: Game development is a challenging but very rewarding process. From idea to implementation, every step requires careful polishing.

1. Stay passionate: Game development has long cycles, requires sustained motivation
2. Iterative development: Don't pursue perfection, make a prototype first
3. User feedback: Listen to your players
